summary: Evaluate local density and gyrotropic pressure moments of an invariant bi-Maxwellian, optionally reducing them by two-plug loss-cone pitch integrals.

identity.relation: Reference bi-Maxwellian and local field/potential state to mirror-constrained density and pressure moments
identity.direction: (b_t, psi, potential_v, species and reference profiles, optional two-plug state) -> local density, parallel/perpendicular pressures and pitch factors
identity.definition: Let C=(B-B_ref)/T_parallel+B_ref/T_perp,ref and T_perp,local=B/C. The untruncated density is n_ref*(T_perp,local/T_perp,ref)*exp(clip[-q*(phi-phi_ref)/T_parallel,-700,700]). Without both plug fields, or with loss_cone_refill=1, all pitch factors are one. Otherwise a two-barrier integral over x in [0,40] gives dimensionless density, parallel and perpendicular factors; n=n_full*I_n, p_parallel=n_full*T_parallel*I_parallel and p_perpendicular=n_full*T_perp,local*I_perpendicular. The implementation partitions at barrier roots/intersection and applies Gauss--Legendre quadrature to each interval.
identity.model: Invariant gyrotropic bi-Maxwellian with optional source-defined two-end-plug loss-cone depletion; not a self-consistent potential or equilibrium solve
identity.geometry: Local magnetic-field magnitude and two named mirror-plug field magnitudes; no spatial metric or field-line geometry is computed
identity.coordinates: psi is a caller-supplied flux-profile coordinate with the historical source contract in Wb; input array axes are caller supplied and only NumPy broadcasting is applied. The callable does not validate the flux convention or convert Wb to Wb/rad.
identity.boundary: Both left and right plug magnetic fields must be supplied together. With no plug fields, or refill exactly one, there is no loss-cone reduction; the active plug branch integrates a source-defined pitch variable only through x=40.
assumptions: The supplied density, temperature, field and potential profiles describe the same species and reference state; their physical consistency is a caller responsibility.

Particle mass is validated but does not enter the returned moment formulas. Signed nonzero charge is supported by this operator, although a consuming positive-ion closure can impose a narrower requirement.
The historical Wb label for psi does not establish compatibility with SciRel functions using another poloidal-flux convention.

inputs.name: b_t
inputs.shape: scalar or array; broadcasts with psi and potential_v
inputs.constraints: All broadcast elements finite and strictly positive.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Caller flux-profile coordinate and shared shape carrier.
inputs.shape: scalar or array; broadcasts with b_t and potential_v
inputs.constraints: All broadcast elements finite; no range or flux-normalization check.

inputs.name: potential_v
inputs.shape: scalar or array; broadcasts with b_t and psi

inputs.name: mass_kg
inputs.description: Species mass, validated but not used in the evaluated moments.

inputs.name: charge_c
inputs.description: Signed species charge q in the potential factor and plug barriers.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonzero; the function does not require a positive ion. Later arithmetic uses the original argument after float-based validation.

inputs.name: density_ref_m3
inputs.shape: scalar, broadcast-compatible array or callable(psi) returning such values
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated elements must be finite and nonnegative.

inputs.name: temperature_parallel_j
inputs.shape: scalar, broadcast-compatible array or callable(psi) returning such values
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated elements must be finite and strictly positive.

inputs.name: temperature_perpendicular_ref_j
inputs.description: Reference perpendicular temperature energy scale T_perp,ref.
inputs.shape: scalar, broadcast-compatible array or callable(psi) returning such values
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated elements must be finite and strictly positive.

inputs.name: b_ref_t
inputs.shape: scalar, broadcast-compatible array or callable(psi) returning such values
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated elements must be finite and strictly positive; the derived coefficient C must also be positive.

inputs.name: phi_ref_v
inputs.shape: scalar, broadcast-compatible array or callable(psi) returning such values
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values

inputs.name: b_plug_left_t
inputs.shape: None, scalar, broadcast-compatible array or callable(psi)
inputs.dtype: null, real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Must be supplied together with b_plug_right_t; evaluated for finiteness and positivity only when the plug branch is active (refill != 1).

inputs.name: b_plug_right_t
inputs.shape: None, scalar, broadcast-compatible array or callable(psi)
inputs.dtype: null, real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Must be supplied together with b_plug_left_t; evaluated for finiteness and positivity only when the plug branch is active (refill != 1).

inputs.name: phi_plug_left_v
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated for finiteness only when both plug fields are supplied and refill != 1.

inputs.name: phi_plug_right_v
inputs.dtype: real array-like or callable yielding float64-convertible values
inputs.constraints: Evaluated for finiteness only when both plug fields are supplied and refill != 1.

inputs.name: loss_cone_refill
inputs.description: Fraction restoring the unconfined bi-Maxwellian pitch occupation.
inputs.constraints: Finite in [0,1]; zero is the source-defined empty loss cone and one bypasses plug integration. Later arithmetic uses the original argument after float-based validation.

inputs.name: quadrature_order
inputs.description: Gauss--Legendre nodes per internal pitch interval.
inputs.constraints: Finite with int(quadrature_order) at least 8; exact integer-valued input is not enforced. Used only when plug integration is active.

outputs.name: density_m3
outputs.description: Local density after the pitch-occupation factor.

outputs.name: p_parallel_pa
outputs.description: Gyrotropic parallel pressure moment after pitch reduction.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular_pa
outputs.description: Gyrotropic perpendicular pressure moment after pitch reduction.

outputs.name: temperature_parallel_j
outputs.description: Evaluated input parallel temperature parameter, not a pressure-over-depleted-density effective temperature.
outputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive on successful validated input.

outputs.name: temperature_perpendicular_local_j
outputs.description: Untruncated local perpendicular temperature parameter B/C.
outputs.constraints: Requires C>0; not reconstructed from depleted pressure and density.

outputs.name: untruncated_density_m3
outputs.description: Local bi-Maxwellian density before plug pitch reduction.
outputs.constraints: Includes temperature ratio and clipped potential exponent.

outputs.name: density_pitch_integral
outputs.constraints: One when plug integration is bypassed; no quadrature axis is returned.

outputs.name: parallel_pitch_integral
outputs.constraints: One when plug integration is bypassed; no quadrature axis is returned.

outputs.name: perpendicular_pitch_integral
outputs.constraints: One when plug integration is bypassed; no quadrature axis is returned.

preconditions: Inputs describe one compatible species/reference state and all profile callables accept the broadcast psi array.
B, B_ref and both temperature energies are positive, and C=(B-B_ref)/T_parallel+B_ref/T_perp,ref remains positive everywhere.
supported: Untruncated scalar or broadcast-array bi-Maxwellian moments and vectorized psi-dependent reference profiles.
Source-defined two-plug loss-cone depletion and fractional refill with finite Gauss--Legendre pitch integration.
excluded: Determining the electrostatic potential, mirror equilibrium or a self-consistent particle distribution from the returned moments alone.
A one-sided plug model, automatic flux-unit conversion, arbitrary field-line geometry or an error estimate for finite pitch quadrature.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for invalid mass/charge, refill or quadrature control, one-sided plug fields, nonfinite or nonpositive local/reference field and temperatures, negative reference density, nonfinite potential/profile results, or nonbroadcastable shapes. Nonnumeric conversion/callable errors may propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises FloatingPointError when C is nonpositive. The potential exponent is clipped to [-700,700], and no general finite-output or integration-error check is performed; overflow, underflow, floating warnings or NumPy/SciPy failures may propagate or produce extreme results.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No nonlinear iteration is performed. The active plug branch uses fixed-order quadrature and does not report convergence or an error bound.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned on an exception; all nine fields are assembled together after computation.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel maintains a compatible public implementation associated with a saved historical Pleiades bi-Maxwellian mirror-moment operator. The saved import and old admitted-assets records give development lineage, not a qualified current L1 delivery or current expert recognition; source and maintained-module bytes are not asserted identical.
source_kinds: saved historical Pleiades operator description and implementation mapping
SciRel direct analytic-limit, plug-quadrature and invalid-input regression tests

python.signature: evaluate_mirror_constrained_moments(b_t, psi, potential_v, mass_kg, charge_c, density_ref_m3, temperature_parallel_j, temperature_perpendicular_ref_j, b_ref_t, phi_ref_v=0.0, b_plug_left_t=None, b_plug_right_t=None, phi_plug_left_v=0.0, phi_plug_right_v=0.0, loss_cone_refill=0.0, quadrature_order=32)

example.description: Check the analytic untruncated bi-Maxwellian limit at two magnetic-field values.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import evaluate_mirror_constrained_moments
e = 1.602176634e-19
b = np.array([1.0, 2.0])
r = evaluate_mirror_constrained_moments(b, np.zeros(2), 0.0, 1.67262192595e-27, e, 2.0e18, 1200.0*e, 2400.0*e, 1.0)
t_perp = b / ((b-1.0)/(1200.0*e) + 1.0/(2400.0*e))
n = 2.0e18*t_perp/(2400.0*e)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['density_m3'], n)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['p_parallel_pa'], n*1200.0*e)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['p_perpendicular_pa'], n*t_perp)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['density_pitch_integral'], 1.0)
example.expected: At B=1 and 2 T, density and both pressures match the stated untruncated analytic relations and the density pitch factor is one.

scope: Untruncated density and gyrotropic pressures against closed-form expressions over three B samples.
Two-plug loss-cone reductions and independent adaptive integration of three pitch factors at two field values for one selected barrier case.
Source-default empty loss cone, refill-one recovery, one-sided plug rejection, vectorized psi profile equivalence and selected nonfinite control rejection.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests support selected analytic, plugged and invalid-input cases; the independent adaptive integration compares one selected two-barrier case at quadrature_order=256 with rtol=3e-8 and atol=1e-10. They do not establish all profile domains, physical correctness of every source-defined loss-cone model, convergence of the default 32-node quadrature, compatibility with other flux conventions, current expert recognition or public release.
known_limitations: The active pitch integral truncates x at 40 and has no returned quadrature error estimate; plug inputs are not evaluated when refill is exactly one.
The potential exponent is clipped, and arithmetic overflow or underflow is not uniformly rejected.
Mass is validated but not used in these moments; downstream closures may require positive-ion charge despite this callable accepting either sign.
The historical psi unit is Wb, whereas other SciRel field assets may use Wb/rad; no connector equivalence is established.
Public distribution licensing and current-version expert recognition remain pending.
